curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When playful indoor antics spiral completely out of hand, the siblings face a wild race to regain control and expel their chaotic visitor before mom returns.
curatedMovie.description: Left home alone on a rainy afternoon while their mother is out, siblings Conrad and Sally find their quiet house upended when the mischievous Cat in the Hat arrives and unleashes unruly fantasy mayhem.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, lighthearted, and easy to watch, blending broad physical comedy with colorful, chaotic family fantasy.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at an energetic 82 minutes, Bo Welch's live-action family comedy offers fast-paced, surreal slapstick designed for easy, low-stress entertainment.
